text: North York Community Council has delegated authority to appoint and remove directors from the boards of Businesses Improvement Areas that fall within its geographic boundaries. The purpose of this report is to recommend that North York Community Council remove a director from the Willowdale Businesses Improvement Area Board of Management.
North York Community Council: 1. Removed the following director from the Yonge North York Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below: Abbasova, Liya
